01-login.title: First sign-in
01-login.caption: A new browser opens in English. Paste the key from .state/access-key, or sign in with an account.

02-empty.title: An empty installation
02-empty.caption: After sign-in a clean install shows only the Local server and no sessions.

41-phone-empty.title: Empty state on a phone
41-phone-empty.caption: At 390 px the same actions stay on screen as separate buttons.

03-settings.title: Settings
03-settings.caption: The gear opens language, Trash location, accounts and devices.

04-account.title: Create an account
04-account.caption: Accounts can be made only after access-key sign-in. Password fields are never recorded.

05-new-session.title: New tmux session
05-new-session.caption: New session + asks for the server, a session name and an optional start folder.

30-original-terminal.title: Live terminal
30-original-terminal.caption: Create opens a real shell in tmux. The grid fits the window and follows resizing.

06-reader.title: Reader view
06-reader.caption: Reader shows an agent pane as a conversation with code, tables and command output.

07-composer.title: Write a message
07-composer.caption: Shift+Enter adds a line. Enter sends the draft to the pane named above the composer.

08-keyboard.title: Keyboard mode
08-keyboard.caption: Keyboard mode sends each key at once: arrows, Esc, Tab and Ctrl for terminal programs.

09-skills.title: Codex skills
09-skills.caption: Typing $ in a Codex pane lists installed skills. Choosing one inserts it without sending.

10-model.title: Model picker
10-model.caption: Model shows the connected CLI's own choices. These entries are demo data.

11-file-tree.title: File tree
11-file-tree.caption: The folder icon opens the session's server and work folder. Arrows expand folders in place.

12-file-preview.title: Code preview
12-file-preview.caption: Selecting a file previews it with line numbers and syntax colours.

32-file-editor.title: Edit a file
32-file-editor.caption: Edit opens a text editor. Save or Ctrl+S writes the file back to the server.

13-file-split.title: Split file previews
13-file-split.caption: Split side by side to compare files. Each pane keeps its own file and close button.

14-file-upload-menu.title: Folder menu
14-file-upload-menu.caption: A folder's ... menu attaches files straight into that folder.

15-file-drop.title: Drop onto a folder
15-file-drop.caption: Dragging files over a folder highlights it as the destination before the drop.

16-trash.title: Trash and restore
16-trash.caption: Deleted items go to Trash and can be restored to their original place for seven days.

31-image-preview.title: Image preview
31-image-preview.caption: Images, PDFs, spreadsheets and documents preview in the same panel.

46-slide-preview.title: PowerPoint slides
46-slide-preview.caption: A .pptx opens as laid-out slides with text, pictures and tables in place. No Office install is needed.

47-hwp-preview.title: Hangul (HWP) document
47-hwp-preview.caption: A .hwp opens as a white page with its paragraphs and tables, like a .docx preview.

17-chat-attachment.title: Attach to a message
17-chat-attachment.caption: Composer attachments are temporary inputs for the agent, separate from saving files on the server.

34-image-viewer.title: Image viewer
34-image-viewer.caption: Click an attached image to inspect it with compact Back, Actual size and Close buttons.

43-image-actual-size.title: Actual size
43-image-actual-size.caption: Actual size shows the original pixels. Back returns to the conversation.

18-session-folders.title: Session folders
18-session-folders.caption: Create folders and subfolders under a server, then drag sessions into them.

19-claude-commands.title: Claude commands
19-claude-commands.caption: In a Claude pane, / lists commands and skills. These entries are demo data.

20-split-menu.title: Split menu
20-split-menu.caption: Split + picks a session and a place: left, right, top, bottom or a new window.

21-split-workspace.title: Side-by-side workspaces
21-split-workspace.caption: Two sessions side by side. Drag the divider to resize; x closes only the view.

36-vertical-split.title: Top and bottom
36-vertical-split.caption: The same menu stacks workspaces vertically with a draggable divider.

37-detached-window.title: Detached window
37-detached-window.caption: Detach moves a workspace into its own browser window together with its draft.

42-returned-workspace.title: Back in the workspace
42-returned-workspace.caption: Return in the detached window puts it back into the original split.

22-light-theme.title: Light theme
22-light-theme.caption: The theme button switches every workspace and split to the light palette.

45-dark-theme.title: Dark theme
45-dark-theme.caption: Press it again to return to the dark palette.

23-notifications.title: Notification inbox
23-notifications.caption: The bell lists agent questions. Selecting one jumps to its pane and marks it read.

39-light-notifications.title: Inbox in the light theme
39-light-notifications.caption: The inbox stays opaque and readable in both themes.

40-notification-toast.title: Notification banner
40-notification-toast.caption: A new question appears as a banner. Clicking elsewhere does not dismiss it.

44-toast-dismissed.title: Banner auto-hide
44-toast-dismissed.caption: The banner hides itself after eight seconds, or earlier with x or an upward swipe.

24-language.title: Language
24-language.caption: Settings switches between English and Korean. Drafts and file names are kept.

33-devices.title: Devices
33-devices.caption: Manage devices lists signed-in browsers and can disconnect them.

25-phone-reader.title: Reader on a phone
25-phone-reader.caption: On a phone the conversation fits the width and the session list stays at the left.

26-phone-keyboard.title: Keyboard on a phone
26-phone-keyboard.caption: The terminal keyboard fits the phone screen without scrolling.

35-phone-image-viewer.title: Image viewer on a phone
35-phone-image-viewer.caption: Image controls stay compact on a phone.

38-phone-vertical-split.title: Split on a phone
38-phone-vertical-split.caption: An upward swipe dismisses the banner; then two workspaces stack on the phone.

27-phone-files.title: Files on a phone
27-phone-files.caption: The same folder menu uploads and downloads files from a phone.

28-add-server.title: Add a server
28-add-server.caption: Server + at the bottom of the sidebar registers an SSH host. 192.0.2.10 is a reserved documentation address.

29-ssh-setup.title: SSH setup
29-ssh-setup.caption: Setup shows the host key and asks once for the real password to install an app key. Nothing is saved.

48-drag-split.title: Drag to split
48-drag-split.caption: Drag a session from the sidebar onto the right edge of a workspace. The highlighted half is where it opens.

50-server-rename.title: Rename a server
50-server-rename.caption: A server's ⋯ → Rename edits its name in the list. Enter saves and Escape cancels.

49-trash-path.title: Trash folder
49-trash-path.caption: Type a folder in Settings and press Save. New deletions go there; older ones stay restorable in the old folder.
